meaning: Run m3-…-1789300434156 inserted a 0x70 PlacementReference copy inside the head span (at N, shifting N and all 20 007 later records by 0x70 with every pointer word rebased, table entries included). Result: the whole head span constructed (P, copy, N, all placements up to 0x123598) and the copy itself was constructed (class 0x8049C738), but the type-52 array walker started at 0x123598 — the OLD address of the first table record — although table entry #0 correctly said 0x123608: it walked the last head placement and the shifted type-52 array with a 0x10 misalignment (class writes at 0x1235B4, 0x1235D8, 0x1235F4, 0x123618, 0x123634 …, i.e. nodes every 0x40 from 0x123598 with embedded sub-objects at +0x1C), 10 397 table records stayed raw, the tail roots never constructed and the load hung. No stored offset or length reproduces 0x123598 (searched every section, the file header and non-rebased object words), so the head walk is bounded by a record COUNT the file does not expose as a plain word (candidates 1 680 / 1 727 were not found as meaningful fields), or by a count derived at runtime. Consequence: records cannot be INSERTED into the head span without also growing that count; a same-size REPLACEMENT of an existing head record keeps every count, size and table intact.
